response.query: What explicit pilot success metrics (annotation reliability, recording quality thresholds, end-to-end pipeline run) should trigger scale-up or iteration?
response.answer: Pilot success metrics for scale-up include high annotation reliability, high recording quality, and successful end-to-end pipeline runs. These metrics indicate readiness for broader implementation.
